top_2_target_buyers.title: Owner
top_2_target_buyers.fit_rationale: Over 20 years in business serving Ashtabula County and northeast Ohio. Specializes in topsoil and fill dirt delivery to landscapers, homeowners, and contractors. The 'Instant Dirt Quote' MVP aligns perfectly with their delivery-based business model. Small local operator that would benefit from online quoting automation.
top_2_target_buyers.email_status: No public email found - phone-only business
top_2_target_buyers.notes: Business relies primarily on phone contact. Website contact page has email field but address not publicly displayed. Owner Robert Brockway is the principal contact for all business matters. Small operation (1-4 employees, <$500K revenue).

top_2_target_buyers.fit_rationale: Locally owned and operated out of Ashtabula, Ohio. Provides excavation, demolition, and land projects with fill dirt services. Young company with modern approach - ideal candidate for AI-powered quoting tools. Offers free estimates which could be automated.
top_2_target_buyers.notes: Modern, tech-savvy business with active Facebook presence and Gmail contact. Newer company (appears to have started ~2024-2025 based on Facebook page creation). Very responsive on social media. Offers free estimates - perfect fit for instant quoting tool.

research_summary.research_challenge: Brockway's Topsoil operates as a phone-only business with no publicly listed email address. This is common for older, established small businesses in rural areas. Brobst Earthworks, being a newer company, has modern digital presence including email and social media.

brobst_earthworks.script_angle: Modern company with tech adoption - emphasize instant quoting convenience and time savings for busy contractors

brockway_topsoil.script_angle: Traditional business - emphasize 20+ year reputation and how online quoting complements their established presence
brockway_topsoil.note: Ask for email during initial call for follow-up materials
